description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil microbial genome sequencing records from agricultural farm plots with different management practices.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or sequencing record.

farm_id.descr: Identifier for the farm or agricultural site where the sample was collected.

plot_id.descr: Identifier for the specific plot or field subunit within the farm.

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees WGS84.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees WGS84.

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site in meters above sea level.

agricultural_practice.descr: Management practice used in the plot; example controlled values include organic farming, conventional tillage, no-till farming.

crop_type.descr: Crop grown in the plot at or near the time of sampling; example values include corn, wheat, soybean.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of the soil sample in centimeters; for example 0-10 cm.

soil_ph.descr: Measured soil pH at sampling time, typically unitless.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent water by weight or volume; specify method in accompanying protocol if needed.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius.

soil_type.descr: General soil classification or texture class, if available; examples include loam, sandy loam, clay.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for microbial DNA extraction from the soil sample.

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield obtained from extraction in nanograms (ng).

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used to generate the data; examples include Illumina NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore MinION.

library_strategy.descr: Library preparation strategy used for sequencing; examples include metagenomic shotgun, amplicon, single-cell genome sequencing.

read_layout.descr: Sequencing read layout; examples include single-end, paired-end, long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs (bp) for the sequencing run.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of reads generated for this sample.

assembly_method.descr: Genome assembly or metagenome assembly software and version used, if applicable.

binning_method.descr: Method/software used to bin microbial genomes from metagenomic assemblies, if applicable.

annotation_method.descr: Genome annotation pipeline or tool used to infer gene and function assignments.

quality_control_passed.descr: Indicates whether the sample or sequencing record passed predefined quality control criteria.

contamination_estimate_percent.descr: Estimated contamination level in percent for assembled genomes or bins, if available.

completeness_estimate_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness in percent for assembled genomes or bins, if available.

target_organism_taxon.descr: Taxonomic assignment of the recovered microbial genome or dominant organism, if known.

ncbi_bioproject_id.descr: NCBI BioProject accession associated with the sequencing project, if available.

ncbi_biosample_id.descr: NCBI BioSample accession associated with the sample, if available.

data_file_name.descr: Name of the primary associated data file, such as FASTQ, BAM, or assembly FASTA.

data_file_format.descr: File format of the primary data file; examples include FASTQ, BAM, FASTA, GFF.
